uses.title: 1251 · Average selling price
uses.snippet:
SELECT p.product_id,
       COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.price * u.units) / NULLIF(SUM(u.units), 0), 2), 0) AS average_price
FROM Prices p LEFT JOIN UnitsSold u
  ON p.product_id = u.product_id AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date

FROM Sold

uses.title: 262 · Trips and users
uses.snippet:
t.Day,
    COALESCE(ROUND(c.valid_cancel / t.valid , 2), 0) AS 'Cancellation Rate'
FROM ValidTotal t
LEFT JOIN ValidCancelled c ON t.Day = c.Day
